start_date=f"{year}-01-01"
max_date=f"{year}-{now.month:02d}-{now.day:02d}"

# apps/APIs explored (for completion gate)
explored = [
    'api_docs.show_api_descriptions(venmo)',
    'api_docs.show_api_doc(venmo, show_transactions)',
    'api_docs.show_api_doc(venmo, search_users)',
    'api_docs.show_api_doc(phone, search_contacts)',
    'supervisor.show_account_passwords()',
    'phone.login',
    'phone.search_contacts (paginated)',
    'venmo.login',
    'venmo.search_users (paginated per contact email)',
    'venmo.show_transactions (paginated per roommate email)'
]
print('explored_apis', explored)

pw_list=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
phone_pw=[x['password'] for x in pw_list if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]
venmo_pw=[x['password'] for x in pw_list if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]

phone_token=apis.phone.login(username='8506051563', password=phone_pw)['access_token']

# Find roommates from phone contacts
roommates=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    for c in resp:
        rels=[(r or '').lower() for r in (c.get('relationships') or [])]
        if any('roommate' in r for r in rels):
            roommates.append(c)
    page_index+=1

# Resolve roommates on Venmo by email (and name match)
venmo_token=apis.venmo.login(username='ed_wilson@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']
roommate_emails=[]
for c in roommates:
    email=(c.get('email') or '').strip().lower()
    if not email:
        continue
    contact_full=(c.get('first_name','')+' '+c.get('last_name','')).strip().lower()

    found=None
    page_i=0
    while True:
        users=apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_token, query=email, page_index=page_i, page_limit=20)
        if not users:
            break
        for u in users:
            u_email=(u.get('email') or '').strip().lower()
            if u_email==email:
                venmo_full=(u.get('first_name','')+' '+u.get('last_name','')).strip().lower()
                if venmo_full==contact_full and contact_full!='':
                    found=u
                    break
        if found:
            break
        page_i+=1
